checklists.Check Point: Enclosure Safety Interlocks, Protective Glass (OD 6+) & E-Stop System
checklists.Standard Requirement: All sliding enclosure doors drop laser power and shutter within < 50ms upon opening; certified laser protective acrylic viewing windows unscratched; all 4 mushroom E-stops latch firmly
checklists.If Not OK Action: CRITICAL SAFETY: Immediately tag out machine! Do not cut with bypass. Call electrical engineer to test safety relays and door limit switches.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Enclosure Safety Interlocks, Protective Glass (OD 6+) & E-Stop System
checklists.Standard Parameter: All sliding enclosure doors drop laser power and shutter within < 50ms upon opening; certified laser protective acrylic viewing windows unscratched; all 4 mushroom E-stops latch firmly

checklists.Check Point: Main Air Receiver Tank Safety Relief Valve & Condensate Auto-Drain
checklists.Standard Requirement: ASME safety relief valve ring pulls freely and snaps back airtight; receiver tank pressure gauge within calibration validity; tank drain purged daily
checklists.If Not OK Action: Replace leaking or stuck safety relief valve immediately. Open manual bottom ball valve to drain accumulated condensed water.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Main Air Receiver Tank Safety Relief Valve & Condensate Auto-Drain
checklists.Standard Parameter: ASME safety relief valve ring pulls freely and snaps back airtight; receiver tank pressure gauge within calibration validity; tank drain purged daily

checklists.Check Point: Welding Station #009 Wire Feeder Motor Drive Rollers, Pressure Arm & Torch Liner
checklists.Standard Requirement: V-groove rollers clean and matched to wire size, wire feeds continuously without slippage or birdnesting, liner free of metal shavings
checklists.If Not OK Action: Adjust calibrated drive roll pressure thumb screw. Blow wire feed steel liner with dry compressed air. Replace worn feed rollers.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Welding Station #009 Wire Feeder Motor Drive Rollers, Pressure Arm & Torch Liner
checklists.Standard Parameter: V-groove rollers clean and matched to wire size, wire feeds continuously without slippage or birdnesting, liner free of metal shavings

checklists.Check Point: Oven #1 High-Temperature Hot Air Recirculation Blower & Bearings
checklists.Standard Requirement: Centrifugal recirculation fan runs vibration-free, dynamic air balance dampers set for even airflow distribution, bearings quiet (< 70°C)
checklists.If Not OK Action: Lubricate pillow block bearings with high-temperature synthetic fluorosilicone grease. Re-tension high-temp drive belts.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Oven #1 High-Temperature Hot Air Recirculation Blower & Bearings
checklists.Standard Parameter: Centrifugal recirculation fan runs vibration-free, dynamic air balance dampers set for even airflow distribution, bearings quiet (< 70°C)

checklists.Check Point: Spindle Runout, Chuck Clamping Pressure & Guard Interlocks
checklists.Standard Requirement: Spindle dial indicator runout < 0.01 mm, hydraulic chuck pressure 25–30 Bar, chip guard interlock functional
checklists.If Not OK Action: Clean chuck jaws, adjust hydraulic clamping regulator, test safety door switch.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Spindle Runout, Chuck Clamping Pressure & Guard Interlocks
checklists.Standard Parameter: Spindle dial indicator runout < 0.01 mm, hydraulic chuck pressure 25–30 Bar, chip guard interlock functional

checklists.Check Point: 5S (5S - Sustain / Shitsuke): End-of-Shift 10-Minute 5S Habit, PPE Compliance & Handover Sign-off
checklists.Standard Requirement: Daily 10-minute end-of-shift 5S sweep completed before shift clock-out; operators wearing full mandatory PPE (safety boots, goggles, ear defenders, cut-resistant gloves); shift handover checklist signed off with zero unaddressed safety defects.
checklists.If Not OK Action: Enforce mandatory shift handover sign-off; halt operations if mandatory PPE is missing; review 5S audit non-conformance with shift supervisor.
checklists.Check Point / Task: 5S (5S - Sustain / Shitsuke): End-of-Shift 10-Minute 5S Habit, PPE Compliance & Handover Sign-off
checklists.Standard Parameter: Daily 10-minute end-of-shift 5S sweep completed before shift clock-out; operators wearing full mandatory PPE (safety boots, goggles, ear defenders, cut-resistant gloves); shift handover checklist signed off with zero unaddressed safety defects.

checklists.Check Point: CNC Control Cabinet Internal Temperature & Air Conditioner Filter
checklists.Standard Requirement: Cabinet internal temperature < 30°C, Rittal panel AC unit running smoothly without dripping water inside enclosure, air filter mesh free of oil mist and dust
checklists.If Not OK Action: Vacuum external filter sponge on AC unit. Inspect internal fan operation. Check AC refrigerant compressor operation.
checklists.Check Point / Task: CNC Control Cabinet Internal Temperature & Air Conditioner Filter
checklists.Standard Parameter: Cabinet internal temperature < 30°C, Rittal panel AC unit running smoothly without dripping water inside enclosure, air filter mesh free of oil mist and dust

checklists.Check Point: Pneumatic Sheet Work Clamps, Gripper Teeth & Clamp Safety Zone
checklists.Standard Requirement: Clamp pneumatic cylinder pressure 6.0–6.5 Bar, hardened gripper jaws clean with sharp serrations, clamp safety zone optical sensors trip ram before collision with turret
checklists.If Not OK Action: Clean metal shavings from gripper teeth with brass brush. Replace worn gripper inserts. Verify clamp position calibration in CNC parameters.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Pneumatic Sheet Work Clamps, Gripper Teeth & Clamp Safety Zone
checklists.Standard Parameter: Clamp pneumatic cylinder pressure 6.0–6.5 Bar, hardened gripper jaws clean with sharp serrations, clamp safety zone optical sensors trip ram before collision with turret

checklists.Check Point: Perimeter Safety Light Curtains, Deadman Foot Switch & E-Stops
checklists.Standard Requirement: Optical safety curtain stops table travel instantly if operator breaks beam; foot switch requires deliberate pedal action with top safety guard intact
checklists.If Not OK Action: Lockout machine. Clean optical transmitter and receiver lenses. Test emergency trip relay.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Perimeter Safety Light Curtains, Deadman Foot Switch & E-Stops
checklists.Standard Parameter: Optical safety curtain stops table travel instantly if operator breaks beam; foot switch requires deliberate pedal action with top safety guard intact

checklists.Check Point: Main Ram Guide Ways Lubrication & Bronze Wear Plate Clearance
checklists.Standard Requirement: Ram slide ways coated with ISO VG 100 slideway oil, bronze guide wear plates adjusted to 0.05mm running clearance, zero ram play
checklists.If Not OK Action: Adjust guide plate set screws with feeler gauge. Pump grease to guide nipples.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Main Ram Guide Ways Lubrication & Bronze Wear Plate Clearance
checklists.Standard Parameter: Ram slide ways coated with ISO VG 100 slideway oil, bronze guide wear plates adjusted to 0.05mm running clearance, zero ram play

checklists.Check Point: Upper Punch Tooling & Lower Multi-V Die Segment Clamping
checklists.Standard Requirement: All punch segments aligned without gap or height difference, hydraulic/wedge quick-clamps torqued to specified pressure, dies centered over bed axis
checklists.If Not OK Action: Loosen tool clamp wedges, re-seat tooling flat against upper beam shoulder under low tonnage kiss bend, re-clamp firmly.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Upper Punch Tooling & Lower Multi-V Die Segment Clamping
checklists.Standard Parameter: All punch segments aligned without gap or height difference, hydraulic/wedge quick-clamps torqued to specified pressure, dies centered over bed axis

checklists.Check Point: Three-Position Safety Foot Switch & Dual Palm Pushbutton Stations
checklists.Standard Requirement: Foot switch intermediate position moves ram down; full depression or complete release immediately halts and retracts ram to top dead center
checklists.If Not OK Action: Inspect foot switch cable for mechanical crushing, test micro-switches, verify emergency return circuit.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Three-Position Safety Foot Switch & Dual Palm Pushbutton Stations
checklists.Standard Parameter: Foot switch intermediate position moves ram down; full depression or complete release immediately halts and retracts ram to top dead center

checklists.Check Point: Welding Station #002 Shielding Gas (CO2 / Ar) Flow Rate & Regulator Leaks
checklists.Standard Requirement: Cylinder pressure > 20 Bar, calibrated flowmeter set between 14.0–18.0 L/min at torch nozzle, zero gas hissing or regulator diaphragm leaks
checklists.If Not OK Action: Inspect gas cylinder seal washer, tighten flowmeter connection with wrench, replace punctured braided gas supply hose.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Welding Station #002 Shielding Gas (CO2 / Ar) Flow Rate & Regulator Leaks
checklists.Standard Parameter: Cylinder pressure > 20 Bar, calibrated flowmeter set between 14.0–18.0 L/min at torch nozzle, zero gas hissing or regulator diaphragm leaks

checklists.Check Point: Welding Station #009 Torch Contact Tip, Gas Diffuser & Ceramic/Brass Nozzle
checklists.Standard Requirement: Contact tip bore diameter within ±0.1mm of wire gauge (1.2mm), tip tight in diffuser, gas nozzle clean of spatter nodules for laminar gas shielding
checklists.If Not OK Action: Ream nozzle with torch cleaning tool, apply anti-spatter dip gel, install fresh contact tip.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Welding Station #009 Torch Contact Tip, Gas Diffuser & Ceramic/Brass Nozzle
checklists.Standard Parameter: Contact tip bore diameter within ±0.1mm of wire gauge (1.2mm), tip tight in diffuser, gas nozzle clean of spatter nodules for laminar gas shielding

checklists.Check Point: Welding Station #007 Heavy-Duty Copper Work Return Earth Clamp & Cable
checklists.Standard Requirement: High-conductivity bronze/copper clamp spring strong, clamped directly onto bare cleaned steel workpiece, cable lugs tight with heat shrink intact
checklists.If Not OK Action: Grind clamping area to bright bare steel to eliminate electrical resistance and arc burn. Replace frayed earth cable.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Welding Station #007 Heavy-Duty Copper Work Return Earth Clamp & Cable

checklists.Standard Requirement: Secondary mechanical/analog safety thermostat set to 230°C; immediately cuts heating contactors and sounds loud warning siren if PID fails
checklists.If Not OK Action: Test safety trip circuit manually. Never run powder curing oven with bypassed over-temperature safety thermostat.

checklists.Check Point: Control Console Emergency Stop & Coolant Sump Fluid Level
checklists.Standard Requirement: E-stop shuts down drive within 0.1s, semi-synthetic coolant concentration 6%–8% with refractometer, sump clear of tramp oil
checklists.If Not OK Action: Skim surface tramp oil, top up water/coolant concentrate, verify E-stop circuit.

checklists.Check Point: Stripper Springs Tension, Guide Bushing Clearance & Tool Jam Detection
checklists.Standard Requirement: Stripper springs exert uniform clamping force, zero sticking in turret station guide, punch returns to top dead center smoothly without sheet dragging
checklists.If Not OK Action: Disassemble tool holder, clean guide sleeve with kerosene/solvent, replace fatigued urethane/coil stripper springs.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Stripper Springs Tension, Guide Bushing Clearance & Tool Jam Detection
checklists.Standard Parameter: Stripper springs exert uniform clamping force, zero sticking in turret station guide, punch returns to top dead center smoothly without sheet dragging

checklists.Check Point: Ball Transfer Table & Brush Table Top Surface Cleanliness
checklists.Standard Requirement: All omni-directional steel balls roll freely, nylon brush clusters undamaged and free of embedded steel chips that could scratch sensitive sheet materials
checklists.If Not OK Action: Vacuum table surface thoroughly. Replace jammed transfer balls and worn brush blocks.
checklists.Check Point / Task: Ball Transfer Table & Brush Table Top Surface Cleanliness
checklists.Standard Parameter: All omni-directional steel balls roll freely, nylon brush clusters undamaged and free of embedded steel chips that could scratch sensitive sheet materials

checklists.Check Point: Motorized Heavy-Duty Backgauge Travel, Parallelism & Digital Readout
checklists.Standard Requirement: Backgauge stops parallel to blade edge within ±0.1 mm over 3000mm length, ball screws clean, digital position display verified with vernier caliper
checklists.If Not OK Action: Zero digital readout with calibration block. Clean sheared metal slivers from twin drive screw shafts, lubricate bearings.

checklists.Standard Requirement: Heavy-duty spring safety latch closes and seats firmly across hook mouth; hook throat opening dimension 'a' within 5% of manufacturer original stamp
checklists.If Not OK Action: Replace missing or weak latch spring. If hook throat opening exceeds 5% or twist > 10°, retire and replace hook forging.

checklistRecords.remarks: Operational parameters verified normal
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Return all displaced hand tools to shadow board; re-align material bins inside marked yellow boxes; immediately remove any obstruction from walkway or fire extinguisher.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down machine with industrial degreaser and lint-free cloth; apply floor absorbent on oil leaks; trace leak source and log maintenance ticket for fitting/gasket replacement.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Enforce mandatory shift handover sign-off; halt operations if mandatory PPE is missing; review 5S audit non-conformance with shift supervisor.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Pneumatic Sheet Work Clamps, Gripper Teeth & Clamp Safety Zone

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Clean metal shavings from gripper teeth with brass brush. Replace worn gripper inserts. Verify clamp position calibration in CNC parameters.

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Vacuum table surface thoroughly. Replace jammed transfer balls and worn brush blocks.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Motorized Heavy-Duty Backgauge Travel, Parallelism & Digital Readout
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Backgauge stops parallel to blade edge within ±0.1 mm over 3000mm length, ball screws clean, digital position display verified with vernier caliper
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Zero digital readout with calibration block. Clean sheared metal slivers from twin drive screw shafts, lubricate bearings.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Forged Forging Hook Safety Spring Latch & Throat Opening Dimension
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Heavy-duty spring safety latch closes and seats firmly across hook mouth; hook throat opening dimension 'a' within 5% of manufacturer original stamp
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Replace missing or weak latch spring. If hook throat opening exceeds 5% or twist > 10°, retire and replace hook forging.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #001 Torch Contact Tip, Gas Diffuser & Ceramic/Brass Nozzle

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Ream nozzle with torch cleaning tool, apply anti-spatter dip gel, install fresh contact tip.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #010 Torch Contact Tip, Gas Diffuser & Ceramic/Brass Nozzle

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Grind clamping area to bright bare steel to eliminate electrical resistance and arc burn. Replace frayed earth cable.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Chiller Deionized Water Temperature, Conductivity & Tank Level
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Water temperature 22.0°C–24.0°C (±0.5°C), conductivity < 5 μS/cm, level in upper green zone on sight glass, zero pump cavitation bubbles
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Pause laser cutting. Check DI deionizing resin cartridge, clean external chiller condenser coils, top up with distilled water. Never operate if temp > 26°C.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Fume Extraction Cyclone, Spark Arrestor & Dust Collector Cartridges
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Exhaust suction velocity > 22 m/s at cutting table, pulse-jet filter differential pressure < 1200 Pa, spark trap baffle clean, slag drawers emptied
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Activate reverse-pulse compressed air filter blast cleaning. Empty heavy slag collection bins. Inspect extraction ducting for clogging.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Laser Safe / DSP Optical Safety Light Guard Alignment & Mute Point
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Optical transmitter/receiver aligned with upper tool tip within 2mm, beam mute point calibrated accurately above sheet surface, ram stops instantly (< 10ms) on obstruction
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Run automatic laser guard alignment procedure. Clean optical lenses with microfiber cloth. Never bypass safety beam!

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #004 Shielding Gas (CO2 / Ar) Flow Rate & Regulator Leaks

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Inspect gas cylinder seal washer, tighten flowmeter connection with wrench, replace punctured braided gas supply hose.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #003 Wire Feeder Motor Drive Rollers, Pressure Arm & Torch Liner
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: V-groove rollers clean and matched to wire size, wire feeds continuously without slippage or birdnesting, liner free of metal shavings
checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Adjust calibrated drive roll pressure thumb screw. Blow wire feed steel liner with dry compressed air. Replace worn feed rollers.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #010 Wire Feeder Motor Drive Rollers, Pressure Arm & Torch Liner

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Drain condensed water from air filter regulator. Clean porous fluidizing plate at bottom of hopper. Replace worn venturi throat sleeves.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Return all displaced hand tools to shadow board; re-align material bins inside marked yellow boxes; immediately remove any obstruction from walkway or fire extinguisher.

checklistRecords.remarks: Inspected OK. Operational parameters verified within standard limits.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Replace damaged neoprene hold-down pads, inspect hydraulic sequence valve, check piston O-rings for oil seepage.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Store loose tooling sections into labeled drawers. Wipe anti-rust oil on exposed die ground faces. Tuck loose cables inside rubber floor track.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down machine with industrial degreaser and lint-free cloth; apply floor absorbent on oil leaks; trace leak source and log maintenance ticket for fitting/gasket replacement.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Grind clamping area to bright bare steel to eliminate electrical resistance and arc burn. Replace frayed earth cable.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Bending Servo Stabilizer Output Phase Regulation & Cooling Fans
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Balanced 415V output across Y1/Y2 CNC bending operations, cabinet cooling fans running freely without noise
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Check servo drive motor capacitor, clean dust intake louvers, replace defective cooling fan.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Turret Disk Indexing, Shot Pin Engagement & Station Alignment
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Turret disk rotates smoothly with zero play, mechanical shot pins enter upper and lower turret locking bushings cleanly without jerking or scraping noise
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Inspect shot pin pneumatic air pressure, clean locking bushing bores with clean lint-free cloth, check servo indexing belt tension.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Hydraulic Power Unit Operating Pressure, Filter & Cylinder Seals
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Operating pressure reaches 200–220 Bar during cut, return oil filter clogging indicator in green zone, main hydraulic cylinders free of rod scoring
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Inspect hydraulic suction filter, check main relief valve setting, replace rod seal packing if oil ring is visible on cylinder chrome.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Synthetic Compressor Oil Level in Sight Glass (Under Stable Load)
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Oil level steady between 50%–75% of sight glass while compressor is loaded and running hot; color golden/translucent, no dark sludge
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Top up with approved rotary screw compressor synthetic oil (Ultra Coolant / Roto-Inject). Check oil scavenge line orifice for clogging.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Pendant Pushbuttons, Wireless Radio Transmitter & Main Line Contactor E-Stop
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All dual-speed pushbuttons return cleanly on release; radio remote emergency stop disconnects main line power contactor within < 50ms
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Switch to backup hardwired pendant. Replace wireless remote rechargeable batteries. Check main contactor auxiliary contacts.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Welding Station #010 Shielding Gas (CO2 / Ar) Flow Rate & Regulator Leaks
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Cylinder pressure > 20 Bar, calibrated flowmeter set between 14.0–18.0 L/min at torch nozzle, zero gas hissing or regulator diaphragm leaks
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Inspect gas cylinder seal washer, tighten flowmeter connection with wrench, replace punctured braided gas supply hose.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Adjust calibrated drive roll pressure thumb screw. Blow wire feed steel liner with dry compressed air. Replace worn feed rollers.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Verify dual Pt-100 RTD sensor readings. Check solid-state relays (SSRs) and heating element bank current draw with clamp meter.

checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Clean gun cascade contact points. Check gun cable for high-voltage insulation breakdown. Clean center electrode needle.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (5S - Sustain / Shitsuke): End-of-Shift 10-Minute 5S Habit, PPE Compliance & Handover Sign-off
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Daily 10-minute end-of-shift 5S sweep completed before shift clock-out; operators wearing full mandatory PPE (safety boots, goggles, ear defenders, cut-resistant gloves); shift handover checklist signed off with zero unaddressed safety defects.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Enforce mandatory shift handover sign-off; halt operations if mandatory PPE is missing; review 5S audit non-conformance with shift supervisor.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (2S - Set in Order / Seiton): Tool Shadow Boards, Designated Staging & Walkway Demarcation
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All hand tools, measuring instruments, and wrenches returned to marked shadow board cutouts; raw materials (RM), work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods stored within painted yellow floor boxes; walkways, emergency exits, and electrical panels 100% unobstructed (> 1m clearance).
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Return all displaced hand tools to shadow board; re-align material bins inside marked yellow boxes; immediately remove any obstruction from walkway or fire extinguisher.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (1S - Sort / Seiri): Unwanted Tools, Scrap Material & Red-Tag Quarantine
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Machine work area clear of unnecessary tools, damaged jigs, empty containers, and unlabelled items; obsolete/defective parts tagged with 5S Red-Tag and placed in quarantine area; only active production materials within 1m perimeter.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Remove non-essential items immediately; apply Red Tag with date, reason, and responsible person; relocate to plant quarantine holding area.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (3S - Shine / Seiso): Machine Outer Enclosure, Viewing Glass, Drip Trays & Floor Decontamination
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Machine structure, touch panels, inspection windows, and motor enclosures wiped clean with zero oil grime or metal dust; chip collection drawers and oil drip trays emptied; floor within 2m perimeter dry and free of oil slicks, coolant drips, or metal burrs.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down machine with industrial degreaser and lint-free cloth; apply floor absorbent on oil leaks; trace leak source and log maintenance ticket for fitting/gasket replacement.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Waste Segregation: Scrap Metal Metallurgy (MS / SS / AL) & Flame-Proof Oily Rag Bins
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Production scrap sorted strictly by metallurgy into designated colored bins (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminum) with zero mixed scrap; oily wiping rags disposed only in red flame-proof metal bins with self-closing foot pedals; waste oil drums sealed in bund.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Manually segregate contaminated scrap bins; empty oily rag bins into plant hazardous waste holding area; replace missing container lids.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Tooling & Gauge Storage: Die Racks, Clamping Hardware & Calibration Verification
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Punches, dies, press brake tools, and clamping hardware stored in labeled, foam-padded racks with protective oil coating; precision verniers, micrometers, and dial gauges in protective velvet cases with active calibration stickers.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Clean and re-oil tooling with rust-inhibitor spray; quarantine dropped or overdue measuring instruments; sort loose fasteners and clamping studs into divided organizers.

checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Machine structure, touch panels, inspection windows, and motor enclosures wiped clean with zero oil grime or metal dust; chip collection drawers and oil drip trays emptied; floor within 2m perimeter dry and free of oil slicks, coolant drips, or metal burrs.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down machine with industrial degreaser and lint-free cloth; apply floor absorbent on oil leaks; trace leak source and log maintenance ticket for fitting/gasket replacement.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Waste Segregation: Scrap Metal Metallurgy (MS / SS / AL) & Flame-Proof Oily Rag Bins
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Production scrap sorted strictly by metallurgy into designated colored bins (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminum) with zero mixed scrap; oily wiping rags disposed only in red flame-proof metal bins with self-closing foot pedals; waste oil drums sealed in bund.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Manually segregate contaminated scrap bins; empty oily rag bins into plant hazardous waste holding area; replace missing container lids.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Tooling & Gauge Storage: Die Racks, Clamping Hardware & Calibration Verification
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Punches, dies, press brake tools, and clamping hardware stored in labeled, foam-padded racks with protective oil coating; precision verniers, micrometers, and dial gauges in protective velvet cases with active calibration stickers.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Clean and re-oil tooling with rust-inhibitor spray; quarantine dropped or overdue measuring instruments; sort loose fasteners and clamping studs into divided organizers.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Main Electrical Switchgear Panel Earthing, Door Locks & Rubber Mats
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Earth pit loop resistance < 2.0 Ohms, double earth body connections tight, panel doors locked shut with keys, Class-A electrical rubber mat clean
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Water earth pit with salt/water if resistance is high. Tighten copper busbar earth lugs. Replace cracked insulation mat.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (4S - Standardize / Seiketsu): Visual Controls, Green Band Pressure Ranges & Laminated SOPs
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All analog and digital gauges marked with visible green operating bands and red danger limits; laminated Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), 5S visual standards, and lubrication schedules posted cleanly on display board; utility lines color-coded and labeled.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Re-apply missing or faded gauge color bands; replace stained or torn SOP laminated sheets; ensure visual inspection labels and direction-of-flow arrows are affixed.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Enclosure Safety Interlocks, Protective Glass (OD 6+) & E-Stop System
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All sliding enclosure doors drop laser power and shutter within < 50ms upon opening; certified laser protective acrylic viewing windows unscratched; all 4 mushroom E-stops latch firmly
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: CRITICAL SAFETY: Immediately tag out machine! Do not cut with bypass. Call electrical engineer to test safety relays and door limit switches.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (5S - Sustain / Shitsuke): End-of-Shift 10-Minute 5S Habit, PPE Compliance & Handover Sign-off
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Daily 10-minute end-of-shift 5S sweep completed before shift clock-out; operators wearing full mandatory PPE (safety boots, goggles, ear defenders, cut-resistant gloves); shift handover checklist signed off with zero unaddressed safety defects.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Enforce mandatory shift handover sign-off; halt operations if mandatory PPE is missing; review 5S audit non-conformance with shift supervisor.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Chiller Deionized Water Temperature, Conductivity & Tank Level
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Water temperature 22.0°C–24.0°C (±0.5°C), conductivity < 5 μS/cm, level in upper green zone on sight glass, zero pump cavitation bubbles
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Pause laser cutting. Check DI deionizing resin cartridge, clean external chiller condenser coils, top up with distilled water. Never operate if temp > 26°C.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Fume Extraction Cyclone, Spark Arrestor & Dust Collector Cartridges
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Exhaust suction velocity > 22 m/s at cutting table, pulse-jet filter differential pressure < 1200 Pa, spark trap baffle clean, slag drawers emptied
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Activate reverse-pulse compressed air filter blast cleaning. Empty heavy slag collection bins. Inspect extraction ducting for clogging.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (2S - Set in Order / Seiton): Tool Shadow Boards, Designated Staging & Walkway Demarcation
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All hand tools, measuring instruments, and wrenches returned to marked shadow board cutouts; raw materials (RM), work-in-progress (WIP), and finished goods stored within painted yellow floor boxes; walkways, emergency exits, and electrical panels 100% unobstructed (> 1m clearance).
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Return all displaced hand tools to shadow board; re-align material bins inside marked yellow boxes; immediately remove any obstruction from walkway or fire extinguisher.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (1S - Sort / Seiri): Unwanted Tools, Scrap Material & Red-Tag Quarantine
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Machine work area clear of unnecessary tools, damaged jigs, empty containers, and unlabelled items; obsolete/defective parts tagged with 5S Red-Tag and placed in quarantine area; only active production materials within 1m perimeter.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Remove non-essential items immediately; apply Red Tag with date, reason, and responsible person; relocate to plant quarantine holding area.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: X, Y, Z Axis Linear Guide Rails, Helical Racks & Pinions Lubrication
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Uniform thin film of Mobilux EP2 grease across full length of guideways, zero dry friction spots, zero metal flakes in rack teeth, wiper seals clean
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Actuate auto-lubrication pump manual cycle. Inspect flexible delivery hoses for kinks or air locks. Clean helical gear rack with brass brush.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (3S - Shine / Seiso): Machine Outer Enclosure, Viewing Glass, Drip Trays & Floor Decontamination
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Machine structure, touch panels, inspection windows, and motor enclosures wiped clean with zero oil grime or metal dust; chip collection drawers and oil drip trays emptied; floor within 2m perimeter dry and free of oil slicks, coolant drips, or metal burrs.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down machine with industrial degreaser and lint-free cloth; apply floor absorbent on oil leaks; trace leak source and log maintenance ticket for fitting/gasket replacement.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Nozzle Centering, Calibrated Standoff & Ceramic Body Condition
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Laser beam exits exact geometric center of nozzle orifice (verified with thermal tape test), ceramic insulator free of hairline cracks, capacitive standoff accurate ±0.05 mm
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Adjust micrometer X/Y screws on cutting head. Replace cracked ceramic ring. Perform automatic capacitive height sensor calibration on clean test sheet.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Assist Gas Supply Pressure, Dew Point & Solenoid Valves (N2 / O2 / Air)
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: N2: 18.0–24.0 Bar, O2: 3.0–5.0 Bar, Clean Compressed Air: 14.0–16.0 Bar; pressure drop during piercing < 0.5 Bar; zero manifold hiss or line leakage
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Check gas cylinder bank manifold, verify main pressure regulator, inspect high-pressure valves, drain inline moisture traps.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Workstation: Lens Cleaning Cleanroom Desk, Nozzle Organizer & Sheet Loading Area
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Nozzle organizer tray indexed by orifice size (1.0mm to 3.5mm), optics cleaning workbench dust-free (< Class 10,000) with isopropyl alcohol & lint-free lens wipes stocked, sheet loading zone yellow lines visible with zero tripping hazards
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Wipe down optics inspection bench. Restock cleanroom swabs and 99.9% IPA. Sort loose nozzles into labeled brass organizer tray.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Cutting Head Protective Quartz Window (Cover Slide) Inspection
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Completely spotless under 5000K light, zero burn marks, zero micro-pitting, zero thermal haze, seal O-ring supple with no deformation
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Immediately replace protective window cartridge in clean box to prevent catastrophic failure of upper focus/collimation optics.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Waste Segregation: Scrap Metal Metallurgy (MS / SS / AL) & Flame-Proof Oily Rag Bins
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Production scrap sorted strictly by metallurgy into designated colored bins (Mild Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminum) with zero mixed scrap; oily wiping rags disposed only in red flame-proof metal bins with self-closing foot pedals; waste oil drums sealed in bund.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Manually segregate contaminated scrap bins; empty oily rag bins into plant hazardous waste holding area; replace missing container lids.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Slat Bed Table Condition & Slag Accumulation
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Slats flat and straight, slag buildup < 15mm on slat tips to avoid sheet tilt, scrap collection bins below slats cleared before each shift
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Run motorized slat cleaner tool or replace burnt/deformed slat strips. Pull out and empty bottom scrap drawers.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: CNC Control Cabinet Internal Temperature & Air Conditioner Filter
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Cabinet internal temperature < 30°C, Rittal panel AC unit running smoothly without dripping water inside enclosure, air filter mesh free of oil mist and dust
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Vacuum external filter sponge on AC unit. Inspect internal fan operation. Check AC refrigerant compressor operation.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S Tooling & Gauge Storage: Die Racks, Clamping Hardware & Calibration Verification
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Punches, dies, press brake tools, and clamping hardware stored in labeled, foam-padded racks with protective oil coating; precision verniers, micrometers, and dial gauges in protective velvet cases with active calibration stickers.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Clean and re-oil tooling with rust-inhibitor spray; quarantine dropped or overdue measuring instruments; sort loose fasteners and clamping studs into divided organizers.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Dual Shuttle Pallet Table Exchange Mechanism & Chain Tension
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Smooth pallet interchange within 15–20 seconds, hydraulic locator pins lock table firmly into position, safety light barriers mute correctly, chain sag < 15 mm
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Adjust drive chain tensioning screw, lubricate guide track rollers, verify optical interlock alignment on front and rear pallet frames.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: Main Electrical Switchgear Panel Earthing, Door Locks & Rubber Mats
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: Earth pit loop resistance < 2.0 Ohms, double earth body connections tight, panel doors locked shut with keys, Class-A electrical rubber mat clean
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Water earth pit with salt/water if resistance is high. Tighten copper busbar earth lugs. Replace cracked insulation mat.

checklistRecords.checkPoint: 5S (4S - Standardize / Seiketsu): Visual Controls, Green Band Pressure Ranges & Laminated SOPs
checklistRecords.standardRequirement: All analog and digital gauges marked with visible green operating bands and red danger limits; laminated Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), 5S visual standards, and lubrication schedules posted cleanly on display board; utility lines color-coded and labeled.
checklistRecords.actionIfNotOk: Re-apply missing or faded gauge color bands; replace stained or torn SOP laminated sheets; ensure visual inspection labels and direction-of-flow arrows are affixed.
